title: Rahul Vaidya passes beeped remark about Disha Parmar on Pati Patni Aur Panga 2; leaves contestants shocked as fans call him out on Reddit
raw_summary:
Singer Rahul Vaidya has landed in the middle of an online debate over a remark he made on the celebrity couple reality show Pati Patni Aur Panga Season 2. The comment, about his marriage to Disha Parmar, was beeped out on the show, but the reactions around him and a viral clip have kept the internet talking.

The show, hosted by Sonali Bendre and Munawar Faruqui, tests the marriage compatibility of celebrity couples through a series of games. In the round in question, Rahul, Vivek Dahiya and Parmeet Sethi were asked questions about their wives against a timer. Their wives, Disha Parmar, Divyanka Tripathi Dahiya and Archana Puran Singh, sat opposite and used their husbands' nicknames as buzzers.

The hosts asked the men to name five things their wives used to do before marriage but no longer do. Disha buzzed first, and Rahul was asked to answer. His response was completely beeped, and the audio does not make clear what he said. It drew an immediate reaction from everyone present.

Archana Puran Singh could not hide her shock. Mangal Lakshmi actress Deepika Singh said, "Allowed nahi hai TV pe bolna" (You cannot say this on TV). Disha asked him to stop. "Arrey mat hi bolo kuch, galat hi bologe, aur kya. Abhi chup raho" (Don't say anything at all, you will say something wrong only. Please keep quiet), she said. The hosts and others in the room were also visibly embarrassed. Rahul Vaidya claims on national television that his wife Disha Parmar doesn't give him s*x after Marriage. by u/RockstarRanger247 in IndianTellyTalk

Co-contestant Arjun Bijlani reacted sharply, asking, "Phir bachhe kaise ho rahein hai" (how are you having kids then). When Rahul tried to defend himself, saying, "Logon ko meri personal life mein bahut interests hai" (People are very interested in my personal life), Arjun's wife Neha Swamy responded, "Tu hi toh bata raha hai" (You are only saying it out loud).

A video of the moment has gone viral on Reddit. Many viewers in the comments have called out Rahul, saying he disrespected his wife by making such a remark on national television. Neither Rahul nor Disha has commented publicly on the reaction.

title: Ramesh Taurani recalls Alka Yagnik’s rise in the ’90s: “She was getting the most songs”
raw_summary:
Producer Ramesh Taurani recently reflected on the changing dynamics of Hindi film music in the 1990s and recalled how Alka Yagnik emerged as one of the most sought-after female playback singers of the decade. Taurani was speaking alongside his brother Kumar Taurani on Komal Nahta’s Game Changers: The Music Series.

Discussing the music landscape of the period, Ramesh Taurani recalled that established voices such as Lata Mangeshkar and Asha Bhosle continued to be important choices for filmmakers, while a new generation of singers was gaining prominence.

“Back then, Lata Ji and Asha Ji were already established. When we used to make music, Lata Ji was our first preference, followed by Alka and Anuradha,” Taurani said.

He went on to recall the emergence of singers including Kumar Sanu, Anuradha Paudwal, Alka Yagnik and Udit Narayan. According to him, films such as Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak, Aashiqui, Saajan and Phool Aur Kaante helped establish the new voices in the industry as their songs became popular with audiences.

“The idea was that in the ’90s, when new singers like Shanu, Anuradha Paudwal, Alka Yagnik and Udit Narayan came in, these four made it big. Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak, Aashiqui, Saajan and Phool Aur Kaante were hits, and their songs became superhits,” he recalled. How Alka Yagnik emerged as a leading female voice Taurani also drew a comparison between the newer singers and the established female playback voices of the previous generation. He recalled that Anuradha Paudwal was being viewed as a successor to Lata Mangeshkar, while Alka Yagnik was increasingly being positioned as a voice comparable to Asha Bhosle.

“The idea then was that Anuradha Paudwal was the new Lata Mangeshkar, while Alka Yagnik became the new Asha Bhosle,” Taurani said.

According to Taurani, the shift in Anuradha Paudwal’s film career eventually created more opportunities for Alka Yagnik. He recalled that after Paudwal stopped singing for films and became associated exclusively with T-Series, Alka began receiving a wider variety of female playback assignments.

“Luckily, Anuradha Ji stopped singing for films and made herself exclusive to T-Series. This worked in Alka Ji’s favour, as she got both Lata Ji and Asha Ji type songs, whether they were solos, duets or shayari,” he said.

Taurani further recalled the scale of Alka Yagnik’s presence during the period, saying she was receiving a significant number of songs compared with some of the leading male playback singers of the time.

“The situation was such that, among Udit, Sanu and Sonu, Alka Ji was getting the most songs,” he added.

The conversation featured Ramesh and Kumar Taurani discussing their experiences in the Hindi music industry and the changes they witnessed during the rise of the 1990s playback generation. The episode is part of Komal Nahta’s Game Changers: The Music Series, which focuses on conversations with singers, composers and other figures associated with Indian film music.

title: Jailer 2 Hindi release: Makers clarify Rajinikanth-starrer will hit theatres on October 15; say, “There has been no change”
raw_summary:
The team of Jailer 2 has issued an official clarification regarding reports surrounding the Hindi theatrical release of the Rajinikanth-starrer. Addressing recent speculation that the Hindi version may not release in theatres as planned, the makers have confirmed that the film will arrive in cinemas on Thursday, October 15, 2026, alongside its other language versions.

The clarification comes after reports suggested that the Hindi version of Jailer 2 could face restrictions over the gap between its theatrical release and OTT premiere. Some reports linked the situation to a four-week OTT window, reportedly connected to a larger digital rights deal. National multiplex chains such as PVR INOX and Cinepolis are generally associated with an eight-week theatrical-to-OTT window for Hindi films.

This led to speculation that the Hindi version of Jailer 2 could have a limited theatrical presence, particularly in the Hindi-speaking market. Jailer 2 team confirms October 15 Hindi release Putting the speculation to rest, the makers have stated that there has been no change to the film's planned Hindi theatrical release.

In their official statement, the team said, “In light of recent media reports suggesting that Jailer 2 will not be releasing in Hindi, we would like to officially clarify that the film’s Hindi version is scheduled for a theatrical release on Thursday, 15th October 2026, alongside its other language versions, as originally planned.”

The team also confirmed that the Hindi version will have a distributor for the North Indian market. “The film will be distributed in North India by Pen Marudhar Entertainment,” the statement read.

The makers further reiterated that the release schedule remains unchanged, adding, “There has been no change to the scheduled Hindi theatrical release.” Makers ask media to avoid unverified information The statement also addressed the circulation of reports suggesting that the film's Hindi release had been affected.

“We request all media publications and platforms to take note of this clarification and refrain from circulating any unverified information regarding the film’s release,” the team said.

The makers concluded by thanking the media for its support and cooperation.

With the latest clarification, the Jailer 2 team has officially maintained that the Hindi version will release theatrically on October 15 along with the film's other language versions. Pen Marudhar Entertainment will handle its distribution across North India.

The film is the sequel to Rajinikanth's 2023 blockbuster Jailer. Further details regarding the film's theatrical rollout and show distribution are awaited.

title: Rian Mukherjee wins Best Child Actor at Los Angeles Film Awards 2026 for Hindi film Manzil
raw_summary:
Debutant actor Rian Mukherjee wins the Best Child Actor Award at the prestigious Los Angeles Film Awards 2026 for his Hindi film Manzil. Directed by his father and National Award-winning filmmaker Ram Kamal Mukherjee, the lead actors of the film are Rituparna Sengupta, Sanjay Suri, and Abhishek Kumar. Produced under the banners of Dhanbad Talkies and Endeavour Films, the film follows the journey of a writer and a photographer who accidentally meet at a resort.

Rian plays the role of Aron, son of writer Ananya, played by Rituparna Sengupta, who becomes an integral part of the narrative through his presence. "I am delighted that the jury members felt Rian's performance was worth recognition," says his father and filmmaker Ram Kamal Mukherjee. "I think he is a gifted actor, as he never had any formal training, yet he faced the camera and knew his lines by heart," he added.

Rituparna Sengupta, who plays Rian's mother in the film, was thrilled as well. "I have literally seen him grow before my eyes. I still remember seeing Rian when he was born. Ram and Sarbani are like family, and when Ram decided to cast Rian as my son in the film, I knew he would leave an impact," added Rituparna, who also dons the hat of creative producer for the film. Produced by Rajesh Singh and Sharmistha Mukherjee, the film is currently making the rounds at festivals globally. "Rian is a promising actor from India. He competed with international child actors and emerged as a winner because of his natural screen presence and restrained voice modulation in the given space," added jury member and veteran actor Jean Vincentelli.

The first look at this film was exclusively showcased at an award ceremony in Mumbai, where Rian's screen presence was appreciated by prominent actors present at the ceremony.

Rian is the only Indian to win at LAFA 2026, while the other winners are Jingnu Ning, who won the Best Picture Award for his film A Palmful of Stars, and Phil Aman, who won the Best Actor trophy for Soundcheck. Nazakati Maihemuti bagged Best Actress for A Palmful Of Stars. "I am an accidental actor," says Rian Mukherjee. "I enjoy acting because that's the only time I get to see my Baba at work. He is extremely sincere towards his craft."

title: 8 Years of Tumbbad: Sohum Shah launches official merchandise ahead of Halloween 2026 and sequel's 2027 release
raw_summary:
As Tumbbad marks eight years since its release, actor-producer Sohum Shah has launched a new collection of official merchandise inspired by the folklore horror film. The collection arrives ahead of Halloween, as interest in the film continues to grow following its 2024 theatrical re-release and anticipation builds around its sequel, Tumbbad 2.

Sohum announced the merchandise launch on social media, sharing photographs of himself wearing pieces from the collection. The designs feature references to some of the film’s most recognisable imagery and dialogue, including the line “So Jaa Warna Hastar Aa Jayega” and the Hindi phrase “Lalchi Hai Tu”, accompanied by visuals inspired by Hastar.

Announcing the launch, Sohum wrote, “TUMBBAD x HALLOWEEN 💀🫀 Official merchandise is LIVE now! Claim yours on @thenoiseculture. Link in Bio. #8YearsofTumbbad”.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Sohum Shah (@shah_sohum)

The merchandise is available through Noise Culture, with the collection offering fans a way to engage with the film’s distinctive visual identity beyond the screen.

Released in 2018, Tumbbad blends horror, fantasy and folklore through a story centred on greed and the mythical entity Hastar. Although the film initially received a limited response at the box office, it gradually developed a cult following, with its atmospheric storytelling and visual style attracting renewed attention over the years.

Its 2024 theatrical re-release brought the film back to cinemas and introduced it to another generation of viewers. The renewed interest has also kept conversations around the franchise alive as audiences await Tumbbad 2.

The merchandise launch coincides with the film’s eighth anniversary and the Halloween season, drawing on the horror elements that have become closely associated with its world. Further details about the sequel, including its release date, remain awaited.

title: Vikram Malhotra on Abundantia Entertainment evolving their AI division aiOn into a standalone studio, “It is being shaped as a fully-integrated, total capability movie studio”
raw_summary:
Vikram Malhotra-led Abundantia Entertainment is spinning off its AI-driven creative division, aiOn, that leverages native artificial intelligence (AI) technology and tools for premium filmmaking, into a new standalone studio. This development marks a major milestone in Abundantia’s journey to unlock the power of AI to amplify the potential of storytelling and content creation.

aiOn will produce and back original stories and content across fully AI-generated and hybrid - live-action plus AI - projects, and is underway with building its own creative and production ecosystem. While it will remain within Abundantia Entertainment for now, the studio is being developed with a distinct identity and creative mandate, with Vikram Malhotra continuing to lead the initiative.

With production workflows and creative processes becoming ever more integrated with technology, aiOn will continue its ‘Human-First, AI-Empowered’ approach, emphasizing human authorship and creative vision while bringing in AI to magnify storytelling.

It was just a year ago that Abundantia Entertainment launched aiON and underlined its commitment to AI-led content creation. The company has also partnered with invideo on a slate of five AI-driven films over the next three years.

Announcing the studio plan, Vikram Malhotra, Founder & CEO of Abundantia Entertainment, said, “When we announced the launch of Abundantia aiON a year ago (virtually to the date!), we knew this was going to be disruptive, exciting and special. We now take the next step into building with AI. Looking into 2027 and beyond, aiON is being shaped as a fully-integrated, total capability movie studio. Backed by Abundantia’s prowess, aiON will unlock the power of AI and integrate it across the value chain - from research to screen. An exciting slate of films, fully generated in AI as well as live action-AI hybrid, is in the works and begins rolling out in Q1 2027.”

Founded in 2013 by Vikram Malhotra, Abundantia Entertainment has built a diverse portfolio of films and streaming originals, including titles like Baby, Airlift, Toilet - Ek Prem Katha, Shakuntala Devi, Sherni and Chhorii 2, alongside titles such as Chhorii and the series Breathe and Daldal. Its recent film releases include Subedaar, starring Anil Kapoor and directed by Suresh Triveni, and Maa Behen, featuring Madhuri Dixit and Triptii Dimri.

As aiON charts its path towards a standalone studio, Abundantia Entertainment is leveraging its storytelling expertise to extend the company’s creative vision, exploring how human imagination and artificial intelligence can collaborate to define the future of entertainment.

title: Nana Patekar’s autopsy CONFIRMS heart attack caused by blood clot in left main coronary artery: Report
raw_summary:
Veteran actor Nana Patekar died of a heart attack caused by a blood clot blocking the left main coronary artery, his postmortem examination has confirmed. A senior doctor at Goa Medical College and Hospital shared the findings after the autopsy was conducted following the actor's death on October 8.

Nana Patekar was 75. He was declared dead at 5.10 am after doctors attempted to revive him through cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) for around 45 minutes. The actor was at his residence in Dona Paula, Goa, when he reportedly fell unwell. Autopsy confirms cause of death According to a PTI report, the postmortem examination found that Nana suffered an acute heart attack after a blood clot blocked the left main coronary artery. The artery supplies blood to a significant portion of the heart.

The autopsy report recorded the cause of death as, “acute myocardial infarction due to left main coronary artery thrombosis secondary to atherosclerotic occlusive coronary artery disease, a natural cause of death”.

The findings establish that Nana's death was due to natural causes. Doctors had initially suspected a heart attack when the actor was brought to hospital, but the postmortem examination later provided the specific medical cause. Doctors attempted CPR for around 45 minutes Nana reportedly became unwell at his home in Dona Paula. His caretaker contacted a private hospital and requested an ambulance. Since the actor's residence was located less than a kilometre from the hospital, an ambulance was dispatched to the house.

Medical personnel reportedly began resuscitation efforts after reaching the residence. Doctors continued CPR for approximately 45 minutes but were unable to revive him.

Nana was subsequently declared dead at 5.10 am on October 8. His mortal remains were later taken to Goa Medical College and Hospital for the postmortem examination. Nana Patekar's mortal remains taken to Maharashtra Following the actor's death, his son Malhar Patekar travelled to Goa to bring his father's mortal remains back to Maharashtra.

The body was first taken to Pune and later transported to Nana's farmhouse in Donje village. The veteran actor was cremated there with full state honours.

Nana Patekar's death brought an end to a career spanning several decades across Hindi and Marathi cinema. Known for his intense performances and distinctive screen presence, the actor had continued to remain active in films until his final years.

title: Ramayana to release in nearly 40 languages worldwide; Namit Malhotra and team mount an unprecedented overseas release

Yesterday, the makers finally announced that the much-awaited film will release in cinemas worldwide on November 5. They also revealed that advance bookings will commence on Dussehra, October 20. Meanwhile, the makers are working round the clock to ensure an unprecedented release in overseas markets.

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama, “Producer Namit Malhotra and the core team of Ramayana are determined to make it the biggest release ever for an Indian film. The source continued, “To make the film accessible and appealing to audiences across the globe, Ramayana has been dubbed in nearly 40 languages. As a result, viewers across the world will be able to experience the film in all its glory in a language they understand, without having to rely on subtitles. This is the first time an Indian film has been dubbed on such a massive scale. The complete list of languages in which the film has been dubbed will be unveiled in a week or two.”

Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. It is directed by Nitesh Tiwari of Dangal (2016) fame and produced by Namit Malhotra. The music is composed by A R Rahman and Hans Zimmer.

The mythological epic is being made as a two-part saga, with the first instalment arriving in cinemas on November 5, 2026, that is, in the Diwali week. The second part is scheduled for release during Diwali 2027.

title: FIR register against Imran Khan and others over August Kranti Maidan protest: REPORT
raw_summary:
Mumbai Police have registered a First Information Report (FIR) against actor Imran Khan, his girlfriend Lekha Washington and several others following their detention during a protest at August Kranti Maidan on Saturday, October 10. The demonstration was organised in support of the Cockroach Janta Party’s (CJP) protest in Delhi, which called for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

The FIR was registered at Gamdevi police station under Sections 223, 126(2), 189(2), 189(3) and 189(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), according to reports. The provisions cited in the case relate to disobedience of orders issued by public servants, wrongful restraint and offences associated with unlawful assembly. The complaint was filed by police personnel following the gathering, which took place amid heightened security arrangements in the area.

According to reports, more than 400 people were detained during the protest, with some accounts putting the number at around 600 across Mumbai. Those detained included Imran, Lekha and Imran’s cousin, Zayn Marie Khan. They were released later that night.

Ahead of the demonstration, police personnel had barricaded roads surrounding August Kranti Maidan and deployed additional staff to prevent the gathering from proceeding. The detentions took place as authorities maintained security in the area.

Following his detention, Imran took to Instagram to share a selfie from inside a police van. The actor accompanied the picture with the caption, “Apparently I'm going for a drive.”

Lekha also shared updates on social media following the detention. She said she did not know where the police were taking them. After their release, she alleged that the police were not allowing them to return home or arrange a vehicle. She later reassured her followers that they were safe and on their way home.

The Mumbai protest was held in solidarity with the CJP’s demonstration in Delhi, where protesters were also detained during a major police operation. The movement has been demanding Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over allegations concerning the revision of electoral rolls.

With the registration of the FIR, the legal proceedings against Imran, Lekha and the other individuals named in the case have become a fresh development following Saturday’s demonstration. Further details about the case and any subsequent police action remain awaited.
